hooks.prompt: Auto-compaction is about to happen. Write an emergency mini-checkpoint to preserve session state. Steps: (1) Determine the current date and working topic from available context. (2) Create docs/[DATE] - Auto-Checkpoint/Mini-Checkpoint-auto.md with: Summary (what was being worked on RIGHT NOW, not just completed), What Was Done, In-Progress Work (partially completed items with current state), Current Status, Next Steps, Files Modified This Session (full paths), Critical Context (any IDs, URLs, error messages, or decisions expensive to re-derive). (3) Update docs/sessions/[DATE]-context.yaml if it exists. (4) Append to friction register: compaction-event entry with pressure estimate. (5) Keep it fast -- you have 60 seconds. Prioritize in-progress work state and next steps over completed work summary.

hooks.command: bash -c 'LATEST=$(ls -t docs/sessions/*-context.yaml 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$LATEST" ]; then echo "[SESSION RESTORED FROM AUTO-CHECKPOINT]"; cat "$LATEST"; fi'
